7656.title: Native plugin child startup exceeds the Windows test budget
7656.rootCauseOneLine: Historical Windows CI logs show pre-marker child startup consuming nearly all of the enclosing 15-second deadline; the source-loader path remains, but two clean Linux runs pass.
7656.proposedFix: Profile startup in the real Windows shard before selecting a narrowly scoped timeout budget or import-graph optimization; no local failing regression test supports an automatic fix.
7656.caveats: Partial verdict: one historical main Windows failure separately confirmed; all three existing tests pass in each of two clean current-main Linux checkouts. Windows timing, eventual child completion, precise tsx attribution and the reported failure rate remain unverified. Reproduction commands and output are inline in the report.
